meta.name: brand-guidelines
meta.description: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为内容快速应用品牌视觉风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为文档或界面快速套用品牌色和字体规范
copy.tagline_en: Apply brand visual style to your content quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly apply brand colors and typography to documents or interfaces

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会为生成的文档、图表等应用 Anthropic 官方品牌色（深色、浅色、橙色等）和字体（标题用 Poppins，正文用 Lora），并自动处理颜色和字体回退。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 生成或美化需要体现 Anthropic 品牌风格的内容（如演示文稿、报告）时触发。

say.text: 用 Anthropic 品牌风格美化这份演示文稿。
say.note: Claude 会应用品牌色和字体。

say.text: 给这段文字加上 Anthropic 的配色和标题字体。
say.note: 标题用 Poppins，正文用 Lora。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude applies Anthropic's official brand colors (dark, light, orange, etc.) and typography (Poppins for headings, Lora for body) to generated artifacts, with automatic fallback for fonts and smart color selection.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to generate or style content that should follow Anthropic's brand identity, such as presentations or reports.

say_en.text: Apply Anthropic brand styling to this presentation.
say_en.note: Claude will use brand colors and fonts.

say_en.text: Format this text with Anthropic colors and heading font.
say_en.note: Headings use Poppins, body uses Lora.
